title: RKLB Trends as Rocket Lab Reports Record Revenue and Iridium Bid
description: Search interest in RKLB is rising in New Zealand following reports of record revenue and a takeover bid involving Iridium.

sections.heading: Financial Results
paragraphs: According to RNZ, Rocket Lab has reported a record quarter. The NZ Herald also reports that the company reported record revenue. Additionally, Stocks Down Under notes that Rocket Lab posted record revenue alongside a $2.36 billion backlog.

sections.heading: Business Developments
paragraphs: RNZ reports that the financial news comes amid an Iridium takeover bid. Furthermore, the NZ Herald reports that Peter Beck discussed data centres in space as a real opportunity for the company.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Stocks Down Under reports that despite the record revenue and backlog, the RKLB stock fell. The publication questions the reasons behind the stock's decline following these positive financial reports.

faq.q: What financial results did Rocket Lab announce?
faq.a: According to RNZ and the NZ Herald, Rocket Lab reported a record quarter and record revenue. Stocks Down Under also notes a reported $2.36 billion backlog.
According to RNZ, there is an Iridium takeover bid. The NZ Herald reports that Peter Beck spoke about data centres in space as a real opportunity.
